_about: Peer set for the comparable-company analysis. The tiers reflect how close each business model is to Costco's. Rationale per peer is in docs/comps.md.

excluded.AMZN: Earnings driven by AWS and advertising, so retail economics are not separable
excluded.SFM, ACI: Sprouts is a niche natural-food grocer. Albertsons was under a pending merger with Kroger during 2024, which distorted its price

negative_or_distorted.DLTR: LTM GAAP operating income is negative after Family Dollar goodwill and asset impairments. EV/EBITDA and P/E are not meaningful; only EV/Revenue is used.
